think_procedure: Identify the knob’s type and allowed values from PostgreSQL documentation.
Check whether the knob is numerical and has an inherent ordered scale.
Look for any sentinel/special numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/auto) rather than just changing magnitude.
If such sentinel values exist, classify as a special knob and list the special value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
